fullTextEN: Hi, everyone.
I am Nika.
I come from China.

fullTextZH: 现在住在安徽省合肥市。
fullTextEN: I currently live in Hefei, Anhui Province.

fullTextZH: 有一个中国很有名的高中，
fullTextEN: There is a very famous high school in China,
called Maotanchang High School.

fullTextZH: 它还有一个名字叫做高考工厂。
fullTextEN: It also has a nickname called the Gaokao Factory.

fullTextZH: 因为这个学校对学生非常严格，
fullTextEN: Because this school is very strict with students,
the pressure of studying is very high.
You have to get up at five or six in the morning,
and you can't leave school until 11 at night.

fullTextZH: 那这个学校它在大山里，
fullTextEN: This school is located in the mountains,
very far from the city.

fullTextZH: 就算你想逃学都跑不出去。
fullTextEN: Even if you want to skip school, you can't get out.

fullTextZH: 我找到了这个学校的一个学生，
fullTextEN: I found a student from this school,
let's listen together,

fullTextZH: 他在这个高考工厂是怎么生活的吧。
fullTextEN: to how he lives in this Gaokao Factory.

fullTextZH: 因为你不是在毛坦厂中学读书的吗？
fullTextEN: Because weren't you studying at Maotanchang High School?
When you were in school,
what time did you get up?
What time do you usually go to bed?
I usually get up at 6:30 in the morning,
I need to be at school by 7 o'clock.
Then at night, it's 11 o'clock,
School ends.
Uh,

fullTextZH: 晚上睡觉的时间可能稍微更晚一点。
fullTextEN: At night, the time to sleep might be a bit later.

fullTextZH: 嗯，大约都是晚上1点钟左右睡觉了。
fullTextEN: Hmm, it's usually around 1 o'clock at night when I sleep.

fullTextZH: 那你们每天这个睡眠的
fullTextEN: So your daily sleep
time is actually still very little.
So, uh, at school,

fullTextZH: 就是你们一个班大概有多少同学？
fullTextEN: how many students are there in your class?
One class
has about 160-170 people.
So many?
Yes.

fullTextZH: 你们一个班有160个同学左右。
fullTextEN: Your class has about 160 students.

fullTextZH: 那一个老师他面对这么多的同学，
fullTextEN: So one teacher faces so many students,

fullTextZH: 他是不是有可能他都不一定认识所有的同学？
fullTextEN: is it possible that he might not know all the students?
Yes, at that time we
Hmm, the teacher asks a question.
Can't even recall the names.

fullTextZH: 他只认识那几个成绩比较好的。
fullTextEN: He only knows those with better grades.

fullTextZH: 那你当时是一个人在那边吗？
fullTextEN: Were you alone there at that time?
Do you live on campus?

fullTextZH: 还是有爸爸妈妈就是陪你呢？
fullTextEN: Or did your parents accompany you?
Uh, initially I lived alone.

fullTextZH: 到后面快要高考的时候，
fullTextEN: When it was close to the college entrance exam,
because the study pressure was quite high,

fullTextZH: 是我姐姐来陪了我两个月，
fullTextEN: my sister came to accompany me for two months,
and stayed until the college entrance exam.
If,
if you were given another chance,
would you still choose to go to Maotanchang
to study at this school?
If I were given another chance,
I would go again.
Oh, why?

fullTextZH: 是的，因为那里呃生活呀学习呀，
fullTextEN: Yes, because life and study there,
because there are many people.
At that time, I was alone over there,
Ah, eating and living,

fullTextZH: 包括学习全都靠一个人。
fullTextEN: including studying, all relied on myself.
This also made me become
a relatively independent person.

fullTextZH: 不需要再靠其他人去做什么事情，
fullTextEN: No longer need to rely on others to do anything,
just rely entirely on myself.
Right.
That's great, that's awesome.

fullTextZH: 为什么中国的学生要这么辛苦这么累？
fullTextEN: Why do Chinese students have to work so hard and be so tired?
Today I want to talk about

fullTextZH: 现在中国很严重的一个问题，
fullTextEN: a very serious problem in China now,
the problem of involution.
So what does involution mean?
Imagine,

fullTextZH: 有一个10个人的跑步比赛，
fullTextEN: there is a running race with 10 people,

fullTextZH: 只有跑得最快的3个人可以得奖。
fullTextEN: only the fastest 3 people can win a prize.
Everyone wants to win a prize,
so what should everyone do?

fullTextZH: 我们把比赛的10个人叫一号到十号吧。
fullTextEN: Let's call the 10 people in the race numbers one to ten.

fullTextZH: 第一天跑步练习的时候，
fullTextEN: On the first day of running practice,

fullTextZH: 每个人每天跑一个小时，
fullTextEN: Everyone runs for an hour every day,
This is very good.

fullTextZH: 大家都有时间休息吃饭睡觉。
fullTextEN: Everyone has time to rest, eat, and sleep.

fullTextZH: 但是大家跑步的速度差不多。
fullTextEN: But everyone runs at about the same speed.
On the second day,
Number 1 thought,
Hmm,
I want to run faster than others.

fullTextZH: 于是他每天练习跑步两个小时。
fullTextEN: So he practiced running for two hours every day.

fullTextZH: 别人看到他跑得更快了，
fullTextEN: Others saw he was running faster,
and they got anxious too.
So Number 2 said no way,
I also want to run faster.
Number 2 started running for 3 hours every day.

fullTextZH: 看到2号开始每天跑3个小时，
fullTextEN: Seeing Number 2 start running for 3 hours every day,
Number 3 worked even harder,
and started running for 4 hours every day.
In the end,

fullTextZH: 每个人每天都开始要跑更长的时间。
fullTextEN: everyone started running for longer every day.
Start running for 5 hours, 6 hours,
even 8 hours.

fullTextZH: 可是这个比赛只有一二三名，
fullTextEN: But this competition only has first, second, and third places,
three people can win a prize.

fullTextZH: 每个人花的时间变多了，
fullTextEN: Everyone spends more time,

fullTextZH: 但是还是只有3个人可以得奖。
fullTextEN: but still only 3 people can win a prize.
Moreover, everyone is very tired,
no time to eat,
no time to sleep,
also no time to play.

fullTextZH: 大家花的时间越来越多，
fullTextEN: Everyone spends more and more time,

fullTextZH: 但是大家的生活并没有一起变得更好。
fullTextEN: but everyone's life hasn't gotten better together.
This is involution.
Do you know?

fullTextZH: 在中国考大学特别重要。
fullTextEN: In China, getting into college is especially important.

fullTextZH: 考上好的大学才会有好的工作。
fullTextEN: Only by getting into a good college can you have a good job.

fullTextZH: 以前我们每天学习8小时，
fullTextEN: In the past, we studied 8 hours a day,
and could get into a good college.

fullTextZH: 现在有些学生每天学习12个小时，
fullTextEN: Now some students study 12 hours a day,
even longer.
They don't watch TV,
don't play games,
even study on weekends.
Why?

fullTextZH: 因为他们害怕别人的学习时间更久，
fullTextEN: Because they fear others study longer,
they will fall behind.

fullTextZH: 结果呢，所有的学生都学得更久，
fullTextEN: As a result, all students study longer,
everyone becomes more tired,
and more stressed.

fullTextZH: 但能上好大学的人数没有变。
fullTextEN: But the number of people getting into good universities hasn't changed.
This is involution.
Being a student in China,
is very hard and tiring.

fullTextZH: 那在中国工作怎么样呢？
fullTextEN: So how about working in China?

fullTextZH: 在中国工作也非常辛苦，
fullTextEN: Working in China is also very hard,
very tiring.

fullTextZH: 但是有的人他们开始找到了新的方向。
fullTextEN: But some people have started to find new directions.
For example, delivery people.
There is a person,
his name is Yi Ge,
His English name is Eason.
He is a delivery person.
His job is delivering food.
He has been delivering food for many years.

fullTextZH: 他在几年前觉得生活很难，
fullTextEN: A few years ago, he felt life was hard,
When there was no hope,
he started learning English.
Yes, he is interested in English,

fullTextZH: 而且他越学习越喜欢英语。
fullTextEN: and the more he studied, the more he liked English.
He shared his daily life,

fullTextZH: 也就是送外卖和学英语的过程，
fullTextEN: which is delivering food and learning English,
online.
After work every day,
he studies English at home.

fullTextZH: 别的外卖员工作结束都在休息，
fullTextEN: Other delivery people rest after work,
but he continues to study English.

fullTextZH: 他不在送外卖的这件事情上
fullTextEN: He doesn't compete with others in delivering food,
and compete with everyone.

fullTextZH: 他不是疯狂的送外卖送很长的时间，
fullTextEN: He doesn't crazily deliver food for long hours,

fullTextZH: 而是找到了另外的一条路，
fullTextEN: but found another path.

fullTextZH: 让自己成为了一个会说英语的外卖员。
fullTextEN: He made himself into a food delivery person who can speak English.

fullTextZH: 在网上很多人都非常喜欢他。
fullTextEN: Many people online really like him.
Now he can deliver food again,
and also speak English.

fullTextZH: 他还来给中国旅游的外国人做导游。
fullTextEN: He also guides foreign tourists in China.
I watched many of his videos,

fullTextZH: 我觉得他的英语说的真的很不错，
fullTextEN: I think his English is really quite good,
much better than mine.
I also really like him.

fullTextZH: 我们一起来看看他的视频吧。
fullTextEN: Let's watch his video together.

fullTextZH: 你觉得他的英语怎么样呢？
fullTextEN: What do you think of his English?
Is it better than your Chinese?
That's today's video.
